name: shamash-video
description: Animated showcase video for Shamash, made with Remotion

scripts.gif: npm run render-en && remotion ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$PWD/out/shamash-en.mp4" -r 8 -vf "scale=720:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=96:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4:diff_mode=rectangle" "$PWD/out/showcase.gif"
